{{Quote|I didn't know that Anakin ever missed his real arm. To him, the new one seemed so much better, so much more powerful&hellip;|[[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]]|<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>}}
The '''mechno-arm''' was the custom-made [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic limb]] constructed for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after his right arm was severed by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. This [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic replacement]] was far stronger than the original.

==History==
[[File:Mechnohand-NEGWT.png|thumb|left|180px|The hand of Skywalker's first mechno-arm]]
On Geonosis, Anakin's right arm was severed at the elbow by Dooku's [[Curved-hilt lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Anakin survived his encounter with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], and returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to recuperate and oversee the creation of a prosthetic limb. This robotic appendage lacked the [[Synthskin/Legends|synthskin]] applied to some models, and had a skeletal, [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-like appearance; it was designed to be a sturdy replacement, not a cosmetic disguise. Anakin's new arm connected to the remainder of his limb via a synth-net neural interface, a complicated piece of technology that allowed Anakin to register feeling in his mechno-arm.

Anakin's metal mechno-arm was an advanced version, featuring golden, electrostatic fingertips that simulated a sense of touch. Data collected by the fingertips was transmitted through sensory impulse lines running down the fingers and into an interface module at the wrist. This module served as the junction between Anakin's robotic hand and living flesh. The arm's servos and sensors were controlled by a power cell near the thumb. The mechno-hand's motorized knuckles provide Anakin with a crushing strength far beyond the [[Human/Legends|Human]] norm.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], many of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] believed that Anakin lost some of his Humanity because of his prosthetic replacement. Anakin, however, was well at ease with his mechno-arm, and tinkered with it as he did his starfighter. He added strengthened alloy ligaments and armored shielding to bulk up his spindly robotic arm, giving the appearance of a well-muscled arm to match the rest of his toned body, and covered it with a glove. During the skirmish on [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]], Anakin's mechno-arm was destroyed after his [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Grip|Force Grip]] destroyed the geothermal crystal from the [[Siphon generator]] used to power the Separatist base on the world. He had a replacement, which R2 quickly attached to Anakin.

[[File:AnakinMechnoArm-SWCTP.png|thumb|right|250px|Anakin's original mechno-arm]]
Anakin nearly lost his mechno-arm after his fall into darkness and his transformation to Darth Vader. At the climax of his [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|epic duel]] with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], Vader lost both legs and his remaining biological arm to Kenobi's blade, and was left to die on a black sand bank. [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] saved him, however, and set his [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]] to work on the wounded [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] apprentice. Now known as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] was given an prosthetic arm. A month later, this arm was severed by Jedi Master [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]] when Vader confronted several Jedi in the [[Conclave on Kessel]]. It was replaced with another artificial arm. This arm was then severed by [[Subject 1138|Starkiller's clone]], who used his former master's blade on him during the [[Assault on Kamino|Battle of Kamino]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Sometime after his escape from [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] he got it replaced again. During a battle with his son [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] at the [[Temple of Pomojema]] on [[Circarpous IV]], also known as [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]], Vader lost his mechanical arm again, but it was replaced. Years later, after his many failures at defeating the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], this arm would be destroyed by Darth Sidious as punishment. It was soon replaced, and this arm would have its hand severed at the wrist once again by Luke.
